steps.title: Configure App Meta and Project Identifiers
steps.description: Verify package namespace and application metadata for QuickPay Wallet.

steps.title: Resolve Dependencies and Clean Build Configuration
steps.description: Remove unnecessary third-party dependencies from build.gradle and verify Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Fix Manifest Intent Filters and Component Export Attributes
steps.description: Add explicit android:exported attributes to MainActivity and all secondary activities for Android 12+ compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Backend API and Admin Schema Specifications
steps.description: Ensure schemas define transactions collection, logic expressions, and admin parameters.

steps.title: Validate Network Client and Session Storage
steps.description: Verify BackendApi implementation for /login, /register, /logout, and Bearer token data handling.

steps.title: Validate Dynamic Admin Configuration with 1-Hour Caching
steps.description: Verify AdminConfigManager fetches merchant UPI, QR code, and deposit limits with local cache expiry.

steps.title: Check Offline Calculations and Helper Methods
steps.description: Ensure cashback bonuses, deposit limits, and wallet totals are computed accurately in native Java.

steps.title: Review Authentication Flow and Screens
steps.description: Verify LoginActivity, RegisterActivity, and ForgotPasswordActivity UI and callbacks.

steps.title: Review Dashboard UI and Transaction List Component
steps.description: Verify HomeActivity data fetching, live input recalculation, and transaction views.

steps.title: Building QuickPay Wallet
steps.description: Compile the complete Android application package with fixed manifest and verified dependencies.
